source_snapshot.git_commit_note: The supplied source archive did not contain .git metadata; inventory is bound to file content through the Devtool overlay source hashes.

purpose: Install tests that prevent downloader regressions during later browser removal.
Keep external browser handoff distinct from XDM acting as a browser.

remove_later_browser_runtime: Browser launcher and generic browser VIEW filters
WebView, WebViewClient, WebChromeClient and Android WebKit adapters
tabs, browser history, bookmarks, private browsing, site permissions, browser settings, resource inspector and browser download-rules UI
preserve_external_handoff_despite_browse: share-sheet, ACTION_VIEW and browser download-manager action intake

known_baseline_findings.detail: tools/validate-browser-media-downloader.py still requires the browser to live under Media before Phase 37B, while current source has AppRoute.Browser. Browser-era validators must be reconciled during the later documentation/validator cleanup phase.
tools/run-final-release-gate.sh referenced Phase 49 and 50 validators without the tools/ prefix.

ArchitectureContractTest contains historical Phase 37-50 assertions requiring BrowserActivity, AppRoute.Browser and BrowserScreen. Those tests are intentionally not removed in Phase 0/1 and must be retired when runtime removal begins.

phase1_preservation_contracts: ExternalAddDownloadActivity remains a dedicated review-first receiver.
Shared text, subject text and ClipData URI/text candidates remain inspected.
External handoff never directly starts or silently queues a transfer from MainActivity.
HTTP, HTTPS and FTP download URLs remain normalized; unsafe schemes remain rejected.
Sensitive headers and already-redacted placeholders remain safe.
Native, aria2, scheduler, media resolver, queue, worker, offline library and Media3 player source contracts remain present.
The browser-integration module remains free of Android WebKit runtime dependencies.
